### 2026-10-05 — I installed KiCAD and set up the GitHub repo. Within the repo, I created a README file for explanations and plans , when I do more in the future. I also made an images folder within the repo for organ

**1h**

I installed KiCAD and set up the GitHub repo. Within the repo, I created a README file for explanations and plans , when I do more in the future. I also made an images folder within the repo for organisation in the future—a nice and organised workspace always helps with efficiency!

### 2026-10-07 — I started the PCB design today, slowly learning KiCAD, as I was following the tutorial—it took long at the start to figure out what I was doing, but then I got the hang of it. I have finished Starbie'

**3h**

I started the PCB design today, slowly learning KiCAD, as I was following the tutorial—it took long at the start to figure out what I was doing, but then I got the hang of it. I have finished Starbie's schematic now. [late image due to falling asleep after getting to the PCB editor part]
